hints.title: Index as Hash Function
hints.text: Every number in the array is in range [1, n]. Use each value as an index into the array itself.

hints.title: In-Place Negation
hints.text: For each number x encountered, negate the value at index abs(x) - 1 to record its presence without extra space.

hints.title: Second Pass Identification
hints.text: Any index i that remains positive was never indexed by any element, meaning i + 1 is a missing number.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Optimal two-pass in-place index sign mutation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allocating extra sets or frequency counters violates O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space by reusing array sign bits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Employs in-place sign negation index hashing pattern.
